newsitem.title: UK: Greene King current sales and profits good.
newsitem.headline: Greene King current sales and profits good.

text.p: Brewer and pub operator Greene King Plc said it has seen good levels of sales and profits growth in the current year both from its existing retail trade and from the Magic pubs which it acquired in July.
Greene King chairman David McCall told shareholders at the annual meeting that beer volumes were also ahead of last year.
He said Abbot Ale has performed well since its relaunch last autumn and Wexford, its Irish cream ale, is becoming firmly established as a brand.
